annotation.bound_parties_text: The practice addresses Unmanned Aircraft System (UAS) or Broadcast Module manufacturers who produce a compliant Remote ID system and submit a Declaration of Compliance.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: gives sufficient clarity to the Unmanned Aircraft System (UAS) or Broadcast Module manufacturers to produce a compliant Remote ID (RID) System (RIDS)
annotation.legal_effect_quote: submitting a Declaration of Compliance (DOC) to this MOC will satisfy the requirements of the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) 14 CFR Part 89 (Part 89) rule.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Standard Practice for Remote ID Means of Compliance to Federal Aviation Administration Regulation 14 CFR Part 89
